records.title: 10-K
records.text: Twelve months 2022 consolidated net product sales were $681,440 compared to $566,043 in twelve months 2021, an increase of $115,397 or 20.4%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Effective sales and marketing programs, including Halloween and other seasonal sales programs, contributed to higher sales volumes in fourth quarter and twelve months 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This increase principally reflects the effects of increased short-term investments and inventories which is discussed below.

records.text: Cash flows from 2022 operating activities totaled $72,051 compared to $85,298 in 2021, and are discussed in the section entitled Liquidity and Capital Resources.
